w22Inputs.source: fleet/PROMPT.md:31 lab lever ledger — 'per-day best-of selection bound 10.8→24.5% @k=20'; appears nowhere in CONSOLIDATED-BRIEF

denominatorCheck.question: do the 10.8% and the 24.5% share a denominator? (W2-2 §8 risk 1)
denominatorCheck.answer: UNANSWERABLE from this tree, and MOOT — neither input exists on it. Measured 1-best is 68.50%, not 10.8%; measured k=20 oracle is 89.15%, not 24.5%. Both lab figures come from a pre-campaign, pre-DB-repair substrate that A1 records as not recoverable. The derivation cannot be validated and must not be cited as a number.
denominatorCheck.mySharedDenominator: p and oracle here are read off the SAME matrix of 553 satisfiable persona-days x 20 independent single-attempt solves, so they share a denominator by construction; the curve is also published on 640 and on a judged-in-any-replicate set

effectiveM.verdict: W2-2's CONCLUSION survives and is strengthened; its NUMBER does not. m = 1.92 (553) / 2.00 (held-out seed) / 1.72 (640) / 1.70 under smallest-first. The 2.46 landed near the truth by accident of functional form — m is a log-ratio and is insensitive to p — not by shared evidence.
effectiveM.strongerEvidence: 50.63% of canonical persona-days are all-or-nothing across 20 independent attempts (60 never, 220 always) against an independent-draw prediction of 0.05%. Half the population is decided before the search starts.
effectiveM.w22Risk7Refuted: W2-2 §8.7 predicted that decorrelating generation would RAISE m. Smallest-first decorrelates nothing: it raises 1-best 68.50 -> 76.76 and LOWERS m 1.92 -> 1.70. Order moves the population, it does not diversify the search.

c12OrderVsVolume.verdict: DIRECTION CONFIRMED, MAGNITUDE ADJUSTED, MARGIN INSIDE NOISE. C2 at one week attempt MATCHES the shipping baseline at five (+1.02pp, floor 2.02pp) while spending 44% less solve time. The brief's '79.9 beats 77.1' (+2.8) measures here as +1.06 on the same 537 denominator — a tie, not a win. The operational claim survives intact: one line of ordering buys back 80% of the search for free.

c11.briefRow: C11 as written in BRIEF-CLAIMS is not a coherent claim: its '+9.33' is C2's own independent re-grade (row C2) and its '+10.45' is C3's gross (row C3). Neither is a C2+C6 quantity.
c11.verdict: NO SUB-ADDITIVITY DETECTED. Interaction is +0.12pp on n=1659 (about two days) — an order of magnitude inside the A5 floor. C6's marginal over C2 (+1.21) is if anything slightly larger than C6 alone (+1.08). The two levers compose additively.

snack.dynamicProof: empty snack slots move by at most 2 out of ~425 across an 8x budget change (5 -> 40). F5's structural argument, confirmed dynamically: no attempt budget reaches the snack slot.

addressablePopulation.correction: every marginal return below is understated ~1.7x by the diluted denominator
addressablePopulation.caveat: the contested set is defined from the SHIPPING-order matrix and applied to all arms; a day contested under one budget is not provably contested under another, so treat the corrected figures as an order-of-magnitude correction, not a second measurement

costBenefit.dominantArm: C2_WA1 — higher compliance than the shipping baseline at 3.58 vs 6.35 ms/day. Strictly dominant: more days in band, 44% less compute.

shippingAdaptiveRuleIsANetHarm.finding: slotAttemptBudget's pool scaling costs 2.17pp against a flat budget of 20, and the whole loss lands on the restricted diets its own docstring (weeklyPlanner.js:87-101) says it exists to protect
shippingAdaptiveRuleIsANetHarm.mechanism: every keto persona's pool is <=53 recipes so floor(pool/10) clamps to the MIN of 5 for all 18 of them, while their meal pool runs to 49 candidates — the shipping rule searches at most 5 of 49. Vegan sits at 5..16.
shippingAdaptiveRuleIsANetHarm.docstringClaim: 'on a 36-recipe synthetic pool the SAME change moved the best week from 6/7 days down to 4/7' — not reproduced on the real 250-persona fleet; thin pools measure BETTER at a flat 20.

a5.churnNote: C12's comparison churns 293 of 1659 days (17.7%) for a net +1.02pp. This is exactly the shape A5 exists to catch.
a5.singleSeedNote: on a single seed (n=553) the floors ran 1.54-3.60pp; ADAPT→C2 cleared it on all three seeds, C12 cleared it on none

judgedInvariant.note: the 16 satisfiable total-failure days A6 names are total failures under EVERY budget 5..40 and under both slot orders, so A6's hole did not bite this lane — verified, not assumed

method.instrument: backend/scripts/qc/dayDump.mjs, unmodified, under fleet/scratch/W3-5/patch.cjs (in-memory anchored patch of weeklyPlanner.js + mealSolver.js; product source untouched)
method.inertnessProof: with every knob unset the probe reproduces W1-2 byte-exact: 435/640, 415/553, 415/537, 435/623 at s424242 and both replicate seeds
method.denominators: paired tests run ONLY on arm-invariant sets (553 = satisfiable and not degenerate; 640 = all planned). 537 is arm-variant (judged moves under treatment) and is reported as a level only.
method.a5Rule: real at 95% iff |b-c| > 1.96*sqrt(b+c), computed on the pooled 3-seed discordant count

addressable.definition: persona-day is ADDRESSABLE iff it landed in band in at least 1 and at most R-1 of R=20 independent single-attempt solves; days at 0/20 or 20/20 are outside any search budget's reach
